notes.title: Hermitage Release
notes.content:
Hermitage has released! It is out and ready to be played by none other than you!

We are so excited to announce that the wait has finally come to an end! After polishing the game to perfection and beyond, we have an amazing game that is eager to be played by you and everyone you know! 

With a launch so close to the Spoopy Season, we are proud to say you will be more than entertained this Halloween!

Prepare to question the lines between fantasy and reality, and to take on the role of the Hermitage bookshop manager - a former anthropology professor who has strangely never been seen outside of his bookshop. With the help of a hacker genius on the run, a self-proclaimed detective, and a short-tempered legal consultant, you will need to get to the bottom of a series of horrific incidents, taking on the supernatural horrors that lurk between the pages of Hermitage's weird and wonderful book collection.

Don't forget to tell your friends! And grab the game while it's hot!!

Yours,
The GiikuGames Team

notes.title: Hermitage will release this summer!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we will bring the gripping paranormal horror adventure Hermitage: Strange Case Files to Steam this summer. Having already made waves in China, acclaimed story-driven studio Arrowiz’s latest is being fully localized for a western release across all major platforms, bringing the game’s sinister brand of mystery and investigation to an entirely new audience.

With Hermitage: Strange Case Files causing its protagonist to question the lines between fantasy and reality, players take on the role of said bookshop owner -  a former anthropology professor who has strangely never been seen outside of Hermitage. With the help of a hacker genius on the run, a self-proclaimed detective, and a short-tempered legal consultant, players will need to get to the bottom of a series of horrific incidents, taking on the supernatural horrors that lurk between the pages of Hermitage's weird and wonderful book collection.

The game will release by the end of this summer, so please look forward to it and don't forget to wishlist!

Yours,
The GiikuGames Team

Giiku Games Team

notes.title: Launch date update
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

For a text based game like Visual Novels, having a proper translation is mandatory. 
It is therefore in our outmost interest to deliver high quality translations, especially for a game with such an intricate and complex story as Hermitage.

Like everyone else, we are of course extremely excited for the launch of Hermitage.
However, because the localization is taking up more time than expected, we have made the decision to postpone the launch, to ensure that everything is up to our standards on release.

In the meantime, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/giikugames]official Discord server[/url] to receive are latest news and updates!

We thank you for your patience.
